audit_title: TerraNex Step 5 Final Consistency & Provenance Audit

stress_cohort_provenance_audit.source_dataset: Unused raw PlantVillage non-manifest pool (44,858 unused images)

near_duplicate_analysis.independence_qualification: Images are bitwise unique and non-overlapping with train/val/test splits, but share laboratory collection protocols and sensor profiles with PlantVillage. They represent internal out-of-sample evaluation, NOT fully independent open-world farm imagery.

cross_stage_safety_audit.cross_stage_consistency_scope: Filters inter-genus disagreements only (e.g., Stage 1 Potato vs Stage 2 Tomato Late Blight).
cross_stage_safety_audit.healthy_potato_limitation: CANNOT detect healthy potato foliage when Stage 2 outputs Potato Late Blight, because both stages agree on the genus 'Potato' (12 out of 22 accepted healthy potato leaves).
mandatory_step6_safeguards: Fungicide treatment advice must be completely suppressed by default for all potato diagnoses.
Frontend must render an interactive pre-treatment symptom checklist requiring visual lesion confirmation.
API response must attach prominent healthy potato diagnostic advisory notice.
